name: Jadwar [Denudatum, Saffron, Henbane]
indication_description:
This is indicated in-
  • Nervous debility
  • Depression
  • Premature ejaculation
  • General debility
  • Chronic Cold
  • Catarrh & cough
pharmacology_description: This is a unique combination of Denudatum (Delphinium denudatum), Saffron (Crocus sativus), Clove (Eugenia caryophyllus), Castorium and other natural ingredients. It is highly effective in nervous debility and acts as an ideal aphrodisiac. This is also useful in the treatment of general debility, chronic cold & cough.
dosage_description: 1-2 tablet(s) twice daily before meal or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
